negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific ATM / cash-handling / self-service-banking trade exhibition was found. Searches for a UA banking-equipment expo returned only general retail shows (RAU Expo, TradeMaster) and the international EuroShop.
negative_findings.result_summary: UA banking-hardware vendors appear to reach buyers through banking forums and international expos rather than a domestic dedicated show.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The self-service/ATM vendor census for UA cannot be built from a domestic expo exhibitor list; it must be assembled from EMA/BANKIR forum partner tiers, tender data and international expo directories.

negative_findings.description: Sponsor and partner rosters are generally not exposed on conference index pages; on ema.com.ua the conference index fetch returned only event titles and dates, with partner tiers appearing inside individual event pages and post-event news posts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Partner-tier data requires per-event page fetches, not index scraping.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must budget for one fetch per event (dozens per organiser per year) rather than a single index parse.

negative_findings.description: For FinAwards, Ukrainian Fintech Awards and PSM Awards, search surfaced winner announcements readily but full nominee longlists were not retrievable from search results; nominee pages appear to be replaced by winner pages after each ceremony.
negative_findings.result_summary: Winner lists are durable, nominee longlists are not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The nominee longlist is the more complete market census; it must be captured live during the voting window (roughly Jan-Mar each year) or recovered from web archives.

negative_findings.description: The acronym НАБУ collides between Незалежна асоціація банків України (banking association) and Національне антикорупційне бюро України (anti-corruption bureau); АУБ/AUB and ЄМА/EMA are also ambiguous in transliteration (EMA vs. European Medicines Agency in English results).
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-term searches on these acronyms are noisy without disambiguating qualifiers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated query expansion must use full names ('Незалежна асоціація банків України', 'Асоціація ЄМА') rather than acronyms, or precision collapses.

negative_findings.description: Only one page was fetched directly (ema.com.ua conferences index); all other URLs come from search-result listings and are recorded unverified by design.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are candidates with stated confidence, not verified-live endpoints.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic liveness pass must check every URL; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence, not death.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical sponsor and exhibitor lists from pre-2022 UA events (and the 2022-2023 wartime gap when many events went online-only or were cancelled) were not sampled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted Wayback Machine harvest of ema.com.ua, bankir.org.ua, finawards.com.ua and psm7.com award/event pages for 2018-2023 to build a longitudinal vendor-presence series.

coverage_gaps.description: Event-related actor signal on social platforms (LinkedIn company/event pages, Facebook event pages such as the UAFintech page, Telegram announcement channels) was seen only incidentally and not systematically mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the LinkedIn pages of UAFIC, EMA, AUB and the main organisers, plus their Facebook/Telegram event channels, as a separate pointer set; note LinkedIn/Facebook scraping is ToS-restricted and should be manual or API-based.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is Kyiv-centric. Regional events (Lviv IT Arena, Львів International Economic Forum, Odesa/Dnipro business forums) were only glimpsed and their fintech/payments tracks were not examined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'IT Arena Львів фінтех', 'Міжнародний економічний форум Львів фінансовий трек', and regional chamber event calendars for payments-relevant tracks and their sponsors.

coverage_gaps.description: Cybersecurity/anti-fraud event ecosystems adjacent to payments (EMA's SOC DAY Ukraine, BIS/InfoSecurity-type events) were identified only in passing; their sponsor lists carry the security-vendor layer of the payments stack.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat SOC DAY Ukraine and comparable UA infosec conferences as a dedicated sub-cell and scrape their partner tiers.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell produced almost exclusively pointer sources; only one indirect source (bank self-published award pages) and no direct sources were recorded, which is expected for an events/awards cell but leaves speaker-bio-derived buyer-side decision-maker data uncollected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-on pass that parses speaker rosters (name, title, employer) from the top five organisers' event pages to build a buyer-side decision-maker map.

brief: Ukraine's banking/payments event and awards ecosystem is concentrated in a handful of durable organisers: the EMA association (Payments & Security conference series since 2001, Open Finance & Payments Summit, SOC DAY) and UAFIC/fintechua.org (Ukraine Fintech Week, Pay.Forum, Digital Lending, Ukrainian Fintech Awards), flanked by commercial organisers (BANKIR club, DIGITALFORUM.PRO, FinRetail) and the NBU's own regulator-hosted forums. The awards layer is media-run and stable — FinAwards (Minfin + Finance.ua, 40+ nominations), PSM Awards (PaySpace Magazine, since 2016) and Finclub's «Банки року» — with winner pages durable but nominee longlists ephemeral, so capture must be timed to the Jan-March voting window. Retail-channel exposure for POS, self-checkout and kiosk vendors runs through RAU Expo and TradeMaster rather than any UA banking-hardware show, with EuroShop serving as the offshore directory where UA manufacturers such as Modern Expo declare their product lines. Practically all partner/sponsor tier data sits inside individual event pages rather than indexes, so collection should be per-event fetch plus annual diffing, with acronym disambiguation (НАБУ, ЄМА, АУБ) built into query expansion.
